runtime.input_semantics: arch_get_input is evaluated by generated circuit code on every tick; rng/test.si returns the unchanged initial_seed every time
runtime.output_semantics: each enabled architecture-output tick invokes arch_check_output once

samples.seed_vector_encoding: 256 little-endian U32 values in test-id order
samples.trajectory_definition: seed plus F(seed)..F^65(seed) for each test
samples.linear_specialization_consequence: the tested initial seeds span GF(2)^32, so any linear 32-bit first-step network agreeing with F on all tests is exactly F on every 32-bit input

continuous_seed_affine_state.definition: q_t = T(x_t xor s), where x_0=s and T is any invertible GF(2) map
continuous_seed_affine_state.protocol_precondition: s is continuously available because rng arch_get_input returns initial_seed on every tick
continuous_seed_affine_state.scope: algebraic protocol certificate only; a concrete circuit still needs joint XOR synthesis, timing, routing, and in-game verification
